'''Captain of the White Ship''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
When you gain this card, take the [[The White Ship|White Ship]] as well.

You are never [[delay]]ed in [[Other World]] areas.

Discard this card and the White Ship if you are ever [[Lost in Time and Space]].
